purpose: Track reusable platform capability work separately from customer-project iterations and results.

admission_contract.required_generality: The report must describe a reusable platform contract and tests; a host-specific adapter, field mapping, webhook handler, SDK wrapper, or final workflow is forbidden.
admission_contract.authority: Only a complete report routed by the frozen project collaboration policy may create an implementation work item.
admission_contract.denominator_rule: Capability implementation and qualification never count as customer-project success.

candidate_backlog_not_authorized.meaning: IF-01 through IF-14 are pre-portfolio audit candidates, not project-derived capability reports and not permission to implement them speculatively.
